say:1:1130938001:1.text: That's right. We just received good news from another settlement—the animals that have been running wild lately have finally returned to normal!
say:1:1130938001:1.source_cn: 是啊。我们刚和其他聚落取得联系，部落里就传来了好消息，...

say:2:1130938002:1.text: We're on our way home right now! Unfortunately, Akira is as slow as ever.
say:2:1130938002:1.source_cn: 我们正在踏上回家的路途！不过奥奎拉还是慢吞吞的。

say:3:1130938003:1.text: But it's fine. Now that the clan is safe, there's no need to push her so hard anymore.
say:3:1130938003:1.source_cn: 算了，既然部落里的危机解除了，我也就不催她了。
